title: sector_02 DARK re-skin: dark-ice terrain (floors/walls/gates) + dim skyline + Warden HP bar moved to top & encounter-only (TASK-030)
description:
Playtest feedback: make the map style darker. Re-skinned sector_02 with the ice-cavern style_A terrain TINTED DOWN ("ice oscurecido") so it reads dark/moody while keeping crystal texture. VISUAL-ONLY for the terrain (collision byte-identical); the boss-HUD visibility piece touches boss_hud.gd (logic) and is covered by tests.

Scope:
- tools/build_sector_02_tiles.gd: body = assets/tilesets/ice/ice_fill_A.png, walkable cap = ice_top_A.png, both per-node texture_filter NEAREST and modulate-darkened (BODY_TINT/CAP_TINT). Regenerated levels/sector_02_tiles.tscn (8 bodies + 5 walkable caps).
- scenes/elemental_gate.tscn + scenes/anti_magic_zone.tscn: the "doors that block" framed with dark ice fill + bolted pillar jambs (ice_pillar_A); KEPT the element-color energy seam as the DD-003 telegraph (FIRE red / ELEC yellow, sealed-vs-open alphas). NO script/collision change (Blocker/Barrier/Hitbox/Emitter byte-identical).
- levels/sector_02.tscn: Backdrop parallax dimmed via per-instance modulate (sector_01 unaffected); WallRight/Vis darkened.
- assets/tilesets/ice/ (5 committed PNGs) + assets/CREDITS.md attribution.
- TASK-030: Warden HP bar moved to top-right (clear of the top-left player HUD) AND now only visible DURING the encounter (boss_hud.gd hides the track+fill+label while the boss is dormant or defeated; an always-awake arena boss still shows immediately). Two deterministic tests added to test_sector_02.gd.

Green: full sector_02 + gate/zone tests, crucial 61/61, gdlint clean. Theme chosen by the human (ice darkened over lab/amber). Style/tile is swappable (other styles B/C/D or other bundles) as a DIRECT tweak.
acceptance_criteria: sector_02 floors/walls/ledges/boss-step read DARK using the dark-ice terrain (ice_fill body + ice cap), crisp (NEAREST), tinted down.

The FIRE gate and anti-magic barrier are framed with dark ice terrain while keeping their DD-003 element-color telegraph (sealed vs open) intact; gate/zone scripts and all collision shapes are byte-identical.
The skyline parallax is dimmed in sector_02 only (sector_01 unchanged).
The Warden HP bar sits at the top (clear of the player HUD) and only appears during the encounter (hidden while dormant/defeated); arena's always-awake boss still shows its bar.
GUT crucial(61) + sector_02/gate/zone suites green; gdlint clean; committed art under assets/ with CREDITS attribution.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: MERGED to master via PR #10 (merge commit 3321246), CI GREEN (gdlint + GUT crucial 61; nightly skipped). Branch task-060-dark-reskin deleted (origin). Dark-ice re-skin of sector_02 (floors/walls/ledges + both gates framed in dark ice keeping DD-003 telegraphs + dimmed skyline) and the Warden HP bar (moved top-right, encounter-only via boss_hud visibility — also resolves TASK-030's bar-at-spawn concern) are LIVE on master. Theme chosen by human (ice darkened). Style/tile swappable as a DIRECT tweak. Closing done.
